# Troubleshooting decision guide

| Symptom | First evidence to inspect | Likely cause | Scoped response |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Read10X()` says barcodes missing | directory listing | missing `.gz`, wrong directory level, or renamed file | restore the standard three-file names and keep all three together |
| H5 returns a list | `names(raw)` | multi-feature 10x file | select `raw[["Gene Expression"]]`; keep antibody/peak matrices separately |
| duplicated features | `sum(duplicated(rownames(srt)))` | gene-symbol collisions | read with unique features or retain stable IDs; document mapping |
| “layer is empty” | `Layers(srt[[assay]])` | counts-only object or wrong layer | join/select the intended layer; do not pretend normalised data exists |
| QC removes most of one sample | per-sample distributions and retained counts | threshold mismatch or failed library | review the sample separately; do not hide it with global thresholds |
| doublet call fails | counts integerness, cells per sample, package version | non-count input or backend mismatch | return to raw counts and run per sample; record the failure |
| Harmony mixes cell types | pre/post marker and neighbour checks | overcorrection or confounded batch | reduce correction, change batch variable, or stop integration |
| batches remain separated | source and biology plots | true biology, insufficient overlap, or undercorrection | do not force mixing; test shared populations and feature space |
| label transfer is wrong | markers, prediction score, reference coverage | reference mismatch | use a better reference or retain `unknown`; do not relabel by confidence alone |
| `RunLabelTransfer()` asks for ChromatinAssay | assay classes | SCOP path is for ATAC/multiome transfer | use Seurat anchors for generic RNA-to-RNA transfer |
| CellTypist prepares Python repeatedly | SCOP environment log | environment/model bootstrap | let the managed environment finish; record model and versions |
| `RunRCTD()` unavailable | `requireNamespace("spacexr")` | missing backend | install and validate `spacexr`, or declare deconvolution not executed |
| spatial plot is mirrored or shifted | coordinate columns and image scale | mixed coordinate spaces | use one declared coordinate space across all spatial functions |
| DEG has tiny P values but no replication | sample count and design matrix | cells treated as replicates | aggregate counts by biological sample and refit pseudobulk |

## Minimal diagnostic bundle

```r
list(
  dimensions = dim(srt),
  assays = Assays(srt),
  default_assay = DefaultAssay(srt),
  layers = Layers(srt[[DefaultAssay(srt)]]),
  reductions = Reductions(srt),
  graphs = Graphs(srt),
  metadata = colnames(srt[[]])
)
sessionInfo()
```

Save the exact error, the preceding call, and this bundle. A screenshot of a UMAP alone is not enough to diagnose an object.
